observation.visible_scene: An overhead angled view of a large tabletop domino/marble-run construction. Upper-left holds a sprawling pile of loose teal, blue, purple and white dominoes plus a few standing stacks and arrow-shaped arrangements. A tall diagonal wall of wooden dominoes colored red, orange, black and white runs across the middle-right. On the left stands a small blue tower topped by two red funnel bowls, beside white rectangular blocks. In the foreground is a U-shaped wooden track/channel, and to its right lie two long flat wooden ramp strips (one with a yellow triangular stop at its near end, the other with a yellow arrow tip at its far end). A black camera on a tripod occupies the right edge, and the watermark '@HEVESH5' is at bottom-left.
visible_changes: No motion is observable within the excerpt: every domino, the wall, the blue tower, the red bowls, the U-track, the ramp strips, the tripod and the background pile remain in identical positions from the first to the last sampled frame.
The camera framing is constant across all frames (no pan, tilt, or zoom detectable against the fixed table edge and tripod).
Lighting and shadows do not change, consistent with a static interval of an assembled machine at rest.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the setup is awaiting a trigger or has already finished a run; any falling, rolling, or toppling motion occurring before t=0.000 or after t=1.335 is outside this segment.
The mechanism that would initiate motion (a hand, a released ball, a first pushed domino) is not shown.
uncertain_details: Any extremely slow or small displacement (e.g., a creeping object on the track) cannot be resolved at this sampling rate and is not visually confirmed.
The presence of an object on the ramps or track that is not moving cannot be distinguished from empty track at this resolution.
